what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Taiwan (Province of China), as recorded by IDMC.
IDMC's year-end count of people still displaced by disasters rose from 563 in 2019 to 1737 in 2025.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Taiwan (Province of China) list floods, storms and mass movements.
The fact pack records no armed conflict there.

when.text: The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 and 2025.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC recorded 39044 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went.
